summary_1line: Bhishma explains yogic discipline and contrasts the paths of action and knowledge, asserting that knowledge leads to liberation while actions bind beings to rebirth.

image_candidates.scene_text: A solitary yogin sits before dawn on a mountain summit beneath a tree, eyes closed in meditation while the first light spreads across the sky.
A wandering yogin gazes calmly at a clod of earth, a stone, and a lump of gold placed before him, treating them all with equal indifference.
Vyasa instructs his son Suka beneath a forest canopy, gesturing as he describes the two diverging paths of action and knowledge.
